title: ecmwf-multi-agents settings
description: Settings for the ecmwf-multi-agents agents in opencode, in ecmwf-multi-agents.jsonc. The file is read from the opencode config directory and then from a project's .opencode/ directory: project values override global ones, and agents entries merge per agent. Leave a setting out to keep its default.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so editors can check the file and suggest values.

review.title: Review policy
review.description: When the reviewer checks plans and changes. Default: auto. auto: plans are reviewed before you approve them, and changes beyond a trivial edit are reviewed. ask: lead asks you each time. always: every plan and every change is reviewed. never: nothing is reviewed unless you ask with /review.

profile.title: Model profile
profile.description: Which models the agents use. Default: default. anthropic: Anthropic models only. The reviewer uses the strongest model, since a different family is not available. copilot: GitHub Copilot models only, with the same split as the default profile. default: Anthropic for lead, scout and builder; GitHub Copilot GPT for the reviewer, so reviews come from a different model family. inherit: Every agent uses the model selected in the session. Helpers still differ by step limit.

default_agent.title: Start in lead
default_agent.description: Make lead the agent opencode starts with. Default: true. Set false to keep opencode's own default agent; you can still switch to lead with Tab.

agents.title: Per-agent settings
agents.description: Model, reasoning effort and step limit for single agents, applied after the profile.

lead.title: lead
lead.description: Talks to you, plans, hands work to helpers and checks the results. Start here. Settings here override the profile for lead.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for lead, written as provider/model, for example anthropic/claude-opus-5-5. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the model of lead. Common values: low, medium, high, xhigh and max; some models also take none. Default: xhigh, from the default profile. It applies only when lead has a model, from the profile or from this entry, so it has no effect under the inherit profile unless this entry also names a model. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

steps.title: Step limit
steps.description: Most model turns lead may take before it stops and reports. A whole number of at least 1. Default: no limit.

scout.title: scout
scout.description: Read-only lookups and investigations in code, docs or the web. Returns a short answer with file:line evidence; long findings go to a notes file. Settings here override the profile for scout.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for scout, written as provider/model, for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the model of scout. Common values: low, medium, high, xhigh and max; some models also take none. Default: medium, from the default profile. It applies only when scout has a model, from the profile or from this entry, so it has no effect under the inherit profile unless this entry also names a model. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

steps.title: Step limit
steps.description: Most model turns scout may take before it stops and reports. A whole number of at least 1. Default: 30.

builder.title: builder
builder.description: Makes one clearly specified change, runs its checks and reports. Never commits. Settings here override the profile for builder.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for builder, written as provider/model, for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the model of builder. Common values: low, medium, high, xhigh and max; some models also take none. Default: high, from the default profile. It applies only when builder has a model, from the profile or from this entry, so it has no effect under the inherit profile unless this entry also names a model. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

steps.title: Step limit
steps.description: Most model turns builder may take before it stops and reports. A whole number of at least 1. Default: 60.

reviewer.title: reviewer
reviewer.description: Independent review of a plan or a change. Answers APPROVE or REJECT with at most three blockers. Settings here override the profile for reviewer.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model for reviewer, written as provider/model, for example github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the model of reviewer. Common values: low, medium, high, xhigh and max; some models also take none. Default: medium, from the default profile. It applies only when reviewer has a model, from the profile or from this entry, so it has no effect under the inherit profile unless this entry also names a model. No "#" and no spaces. Leave it out to use the profile's choice.

steps.title: Step limit
steps.description: Most model turns reviewer may take before it stops and reports. A whole number of at least 1. Default: 30.
